articles.title: Eight Black Candidates Vie for Governor in Historic Election Year
articles.summary: Only three Black Americans have ever been elected governor. This November, eight Black major-party candidates are on the ballot—a historic high. They represent both parties and could reshape state leadership.

articles.title: Track Defect Found at Site of Lewes Train Derailment, Investigators Say
articles.summary: A preliminary report says a track irregularity was found where a train derailed near Lewes, England, injuring 30 people. Hot, dry weather may have caused the clay embankment to shift. Investigators are also reviewing maintenance records.

articles.title: North Korea Dismisses Scaled-Back U.S. Drills, Denies Trump-Kim Talks
articles.summary: North Korea says reducing U.S.-South Korea military exercises changes nothing—they still see them as hostile. Kim Yo Jong, the leader's sister, also denied any communications between Trump and Kim Jong Un, despite Trump's claims.
